seo.title: Al Haramain Perfume & Amber Oud | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: Al Haramain Amber Oud is the collection that made this Arabian perfume house famous, and you will find many of its editions here.

sc.value:
Al Haramain Amber Oud is the collection that made this Arabian perfume house famous, and you will find many of its editions here. These are warm, long-lasting eaux de parfum, each with its own twist on amber.

The Amber Oud editions

The Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (from £32.99) opens with melon and pineapple before a creamy amber and vanilla base. The Amber Oud Tobacco Edition 60ml (£32.99) is sweeter and spicier, with tobacco and woods. Ruby (from £41.99) brings saffron and jasmine, Black (100ml, £39.99) is smoky with leather and resins, Bleu (from £38.99) is fresh and aromatic, and Carbon (from £35.99) is a clean, green take for men. White Edition, the original Amber Oud 60ml and Amber Musk 100ml are here too, plus the Extreme Gold Edition Extrait de Parfum from £36.99.

L'Aventure and Detour Noir

The Al Haramain L'Aventure line offers fresher 100ml bottles from £29.99. The original L'Aventure (£29.99) is clean and citrusy, while Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense (£39.99) adds elemi, jasmine and patchouli. L'Aventure Gold and L'Aventure Femme suit women who like fruity florals, and L'Aventure Blanche is a crisp unisex option. Al Haramain Detour Noir 100ml (£19.99) is a warm blend of vanilla, lavender and almond.

Compare these with other Arabian perfume or browse the full oud fragrances edit. If you enjoy this style, Signature D'orient is worth a look. Every Al Haramain perfume we sell is 100% authentic and ships from our UK base, with free UK delivery on orders over £40.

seo.title: Perfume for Women | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: Choosing a perfume for women starts with the mood you want: soft florals, warm amber or something fresh and bright. 100% authentic, free UK delivery over £40.

sc.value:
Choosing a perfume for women starts with the mood you want: soft florals, warm amber or something fresh and bright. This edit brings together more than 140 eaux de parfum, eaux de toilette and gift sets from designer and niche houses, including Chloé, Burberry, Guerlain, Gucci and DKNY.

Florals and fresh scents

If you love a floral perfume, UK favourites here include Chloé Nomade (50 ml, £51.99) and the fresh but sophisticated Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense (£43.99). My Burberry Eau de Parfum (50 ml, £48.99) is an elegant floral, and DKNY Be Delicious Orchard Street (£28.99) is bright and lively. Anna Sui Sky (30 ml, £18.99) is playful and airy, and Ariana Grande Thank U, Next (£43.99) is sweet and fun.

Warm and sensual

For evenings, Guerlain Samsara (£69.99) is warm and elegant, and L'Instant de Guerlain (£64.99) is soft and feminine. Searching for a Jean Paul perfume for women? Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold (£62.99) is rich and sensual. Estée Lauder SpellBound (£49.99) and My Burberry Black Parfum (50 ml, £48.99) are deep and sophisticated, and Montale Aoud Damascus (£52.99) pairs oud with rose.

Try before you commit

A miniature perfume set is a lovely way to explore. Mon Guerlain Miniature Perfume Gift Set (4 x 5 ml, £44.99) and the Burberry Women's Miniature Perfume Set (£45.99) each hold four scents, and Gucci Guilty Pour Femme comes as a 10 ml miniature (£19.99).

sc.value:
A good perfume for men can be fresh and clean for the office or warm and woody for evenings. This edit gathers more than 90 eaux de parfum, eaux de toilette and grooming extras from houses such as Dolce & Gabbana, Guerlain, Giorgio Armani, Gucci, Calvin Klein and Azzaro.

Warm and woody

Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum (100 ml, £54.99) is warm and elegant, and The One Gold Intense (£54.99) is richer still. Guerlain Habit Rouge (£64.99) is refined and timeless, and Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum (£60.99) is bold and warm. Joop Homme Le Parfum (£32.99) is rich and sensual.

Fresh everyday scents

For a fresh perfume, UK shoppers will find plenty of choice. Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Toilette (125 ml, refillable, £66.99) is refined, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme (£59.99) is fresh and aromatic, and Azzaro Chrome Legend (75 ml, £27.99) is energetic. Bentley Momentum Unlimited (£31.99) and Davidoff Champion (£23.99) are easy daytime picks. Calvin Klein Eternity for Men Eau de Toilette (£38.99) is a classic, and Armaf Hunter (£19.99) and Antonio Banderas Power of Seduction (£16.99) keep the price down.

Minis and grooming

Calvin Klein Defy Parfum is available full size (£22.99) or as a 10 ml miniature (£18.99), and the Dolce & Gabbana Men's Miniature Fragrance Set (£34.99) holds five scents. To complete the ritual, Philipp Plein No Limits After Shave Balm (£23.99) is a soothing aftershave step.

seo.title: Unisex Perfume | Shop at Swansura UK
seo.description: A unisex perfume is made for anyone who loves it: more than 290 scents beyond the for him and for her labels. Free UK delivery over £40.

sc.value:
A unisex perfume is made for anyone who loves it, and many of the most interesting scents in our range sit outside the 'for him' or 'for her' labels. This edit gathers more than 290 shareable fragrances, from fresh herbal blends to deep oud and tobacco.

anatomē

The London house anatomē makes a collection of eaux de parfum named Balance, Energy, Focus, Order, Expression and Support. Each comes in a smaller size at £28 or a larger bottle at £125. Expression is oceanic, Support is herbaceous and green, and Energy is bright and fresh, so they are easy to wear every day.

Niche houses

Hemel's line includes Rosado (£49.99), a refined rose, and Patchouli For All (£61.99), rich and sophisticated. Mancera Intense Red Tobacco Extrait (£79.99) is powerful and smoky. Serge Lutens La Fille de Berlin (£44.99) is bold and elegant. Boucheron Rose d'Isparta (£63.99) is a full, elegant rose.

Oud, amber and musk

Guerlain Musc Noble (£74.99) is a smooth musk perfume, and Guerlain Épices Exquises (£86.99) adds warm spice. For oud, Montale Aoud Safran (£62.99) is bold and saffron-rich, and Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (£32.99) is rich and warm. Al Haramain Detour Noir (£19.99) is a smooth, low-cost way to start.

Scents don't belong to anyone, so follow your nose. Explore our niche perfume edit, the oud perfume page or the Fresh fragrances family. Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, and orders over £40 ship free.

sc.value:
Our oud perfume edit gathers fragrances built on smoky, resinous agarwood, up to £299.99. Arabian perfumers, European fashion houses and niche labels all interpret oud in their own way, so this page lets you compare them side by side. Every bottle is authentic and posted from the UK.

Arabian oud

Al Haramain is the largest name here, with its Amber Oud family: Gold Edition from £32.99, Ruby, Black, Carbon, Bleu, Tobacco and White editions, and Extreme Gold Edition Extrait de Parfum. Amber Oud White Edition is a lighter, women's take with citrus and soft florals. SAP Saffron Oud and Oud Leopard extraits, Fumeri Oud Saffron For Men and Korloff Royal Oud add more Arabian-style choice. Try our Amber Oud Discovery routine to compare three editions.

Niche and designer

Tiziana Terenzi brings extraits such as Gold Rose Oudh, Caput Mundi, Orion and the rare Dubhe Assoluto. Montale Aoud Damascus, a deep rose and oud women's fragrance, is a natural pick if you want an oud perfume for women, while Aoud Safran is bolder. Designer options include Tom Ford Oud Wood, Gucci Intense Oud, Guerlain Oud Essentiel and Chopard Oud Malaki. Whatever your budget, you can compare every style of oud perfume here, from everyday Arabian oud to rare niche extraits.

Oud sits close to warm resins and spice, so you may also enjoy our amber fragrances or the Arabian perfume edit. Spend over £40 and UK delivery is free.

Floral is the biggest family on our shelf, and this floral perfume edit gathers more than 230 fragrances built around rose, jasmine and white flowers. Prices start with miniatures under £20, and every bottle is authentic and sent from our UK base. Use the filters to narrow by brand, price or size.

Rose and jasmine

Chloé leads with Rose Naturelle Intense, a natural rose accord with citrus and neroli, and Nomade Jasmin Naturel Intense, which pairs luminous jasmine with sweet date. Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum blends jasmine and peach with a rose heart and warm amber. For a richer take, Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold mixes honey, saffron and jasmine over patchouli and leather, a Jean Paul perfume for women who like depth. Estée Lauder SpellBound pairs rose and jasmine with cardamom and vanilla.

Fruity and playful florals

If you prefer something lighter, Ariana Grande Thank U, Next brings pear, raspberry and rose with a creamy finish. Anna Sui Sky blends pear, lily of the valley and lotus, and Antonio Banderas Her Secret Temptation adds rose, jasmine and iris over vanilla at £20.99. DKNY Be Delicious Orchard Street and Calvin Klein Eternity are fresher everyday choices. Each is an easy floral perfume for every day, and a fine perfume for women. Our perfume for women page has more.

Unisex florals and minis

Hemel Valley of Diamond and Rosado offer unisex florals with woods and amber, ideal if you want a unisex perfume to share. To try several houses at once, a miniature perfume set from Chloé, Burberry or Calvin Klein is a smart start. Explore the rose range or our travel size and mini perfumes. Orders over £40 ship free across the UK.

seo.title: Woody Perfume | Woody Fragrances | Swansura
seo.description: A woody perfume rests on sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and patchouli, giving a scent warmth and staying power. 100% authentic, free UK delivery over £40.

sc.value:
A woody perfume rests on sandalwood, cedar, vetiver and patchouli, giving a scent warmth and staying power. This edit gathers more than 140 woody fragrances, from miniatures and grooming extras under £20 to luxury unisex bottles. Every bottle is authentic and shipped from the UK.

Men's woody classics

Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum blends grapefruit, cardamom and ginger with tobacco, amber and cedarwood, and comes in 100ml and 150ml plus the Intense and Gold versions. If you like Dolce & Gabbana The One, the K Eau de Parfum Gift Set is worth a look too. Gucci Guilty Pour Homme pairs lemon and pink pepper with patchouli and cedarwood, and Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Toilette Refillable mixes bergamot, clary sage and tonka bean. Bentley, John Varvatos Artisan and Calvin Klein Defy add more choice, and you can find each perfume for men in our men's fragrance edit.

Unisex woods

Hemel Patchouli For All is built on earthy patchouli and smooth amber, while Hemel Gris balances citrus and pink pepper with woods and an amber-musk base. Guerlain Musc Noble and Épices Exquises bring spice, cedar and precious woods in 125ml bottles. Each is a woody perfume made to share. anatomē Focus and Expression add a mindful twist.

Grooming and gifts

Philipp Plein No Limits comes as a deodorant stick and after shave balm, and Bvlgari Man Wood Essence and Terrae Essence gift sets pair 100ml with a 15ml travel spray. For darker woods, see our oud fragrances or amber family. Free UK delivery applies on orders over £40.

seo.description: Our citrus perfume edit gathers 25 bright, clean and easy-to-wear fragrances from £16.99, with bergamot, lemon, sea notes and green herbs.

sc.value:
Our citrus perfume edit gathers more than 40 bright, clean and easy-to-wear fragrances from £9.99, with bergamot, lemon, sea notes and green herbs. Every bottle is authentic and posted from the UK.

Italian freshness

Acqua di Parma has the largest selection here. Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne opens with Italian bergamot, orange and petitgrain, and the Blu Mediterraneo Discovery Set brings three 12ml bottles to try. The 20ml EDPs, including Sakura and Rosa Nobile, are a neat way to try the house. For a fresh perfume to reach for daily, Dunhill Signature Collection Amalfi Citrus pairs lemon and bergamot with rosemary.

Blue and aquatic

Dunhill Desire Blue blends bergamot with lotus and marine notes over amber and musk, at £28.99. Kenneth Cole Moonlight Blue mixes citrus with clean herbs and soft spice. Signature D'orient Blue is a signature blue scent at £38.99, and Fumeri Blue For Men offers a fresh men's option at £28.99. Antonio Banderas Power of Seduction, at £16.99, is one of the lowest-priced bottles here.

Unisex and niche

Jo Milano Game of Spades Emerald balances freshness and depth in a unisex Eau de Parfum, and anatomē Energy opens with bright citrus. Both make a good unisex perfume to share. If you want a citrus perfume with more warmth, explore woody fragrances, or see our unisex perfume edit. Orders over £40 travel free in the UK.
